title: KnowledgeSimilarityRules
description: Weights, minimum comparable features and threshold of the closest-match retrieval of learned knowledge (ADR-0013 amendment 2). Data, not code: core-go/internal/knowledge loads contracts/knowledge/similarity.v1.json next to lifecycle.v1.json. Score = sum of weight x agreement over the features known on both sides / sum of weight over those features; unknown on either side contributes nothing. $defs/retrieval is the record a run persists on its build_context step (detail.knowledge_retrieval).

applies_to_created_from.description: Knowledge minted from these sources is matched by similarity; authored knowledge keeps the exact condition matcher.

min_comparable_weight.description: The comparable features' weights must add up to at least this, so three weight-1 features cannot carry a lesson; it must not exceed the total weight.

agreement.description: 1 equal, 0 different; for signals the share of the lesson's signals open in the case.

retrieval.description: The closest lessons of one run, ranked by score (ties by title then id), and the decision. decision applicable: offered to the agent. below_threshold: not offered. insufficient_features: fewer than min_comparable_features comparable features, or their weights below min_comparable_weight. exception_blocked: above threshold but an exception fires.

comparable_weight.description: Sum of the weights of the comparable features.

ignored_conditions.description: Scope conditions of the lesson outside the eight features (neq, in, not_exists, other fields): not scored, reported so they are not silently dropped.

message.description: The plain statement the product shows: the closest lesson and its score, or that the knowledge base holds no lesson to compare.
